set-variable.value:
#[%dw 2.0 import * from dw::util::Values output application/json
fun addProxy(obj) = (obj - "isProxy") ++ {isProxy: true} --- if (vars.remoteCall.requestConfig?) vars.remoteCall update "requestConfig" with addProxy(vars.remoteCall.requestConfig) else vars.remoteCall]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Invalid Transaction Id Prefix Error
raise-error.description: #['Invalid transaction id provided in mic_transaction_id HTTP header. When provided, must start with $(vars.requestConfig.micTransactionIdPrefix)']

logger.message: Loading request confguration for API call config: #[output json --- vars.remoteCall]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise APP:INVALID_REMOTE_CALL
raise-error.description: #["Invalid Remote Call. The following remote call properties are missing:" ++ vars.validationResult.invalidProperties]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise APP:INVALID_REQUEST_CONFIG
raise-error.description: Invalid request config: 'host' property not configured

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
import * from dw::Runtime import * from modules::httpClient::ObjectUtils
var micCorrelationIdField = vars.requestConfig.micCorrelationIdField default 'idCorrelationSpwA'
fun updateCorrId(obj, corrId) = (obj - micCorrelationIdField) ++ {(micCorrelationIdField): corrId}
var result=try(() -> isObject(payload)) --- if (result.success and result.result) if (payload.methodStdSPWithAttch?) payload - "methodStdSPWithAttch" ++ {"methodStdSPWithAttch": updateCorrId(payload.methodStdSPWithAttch, vars.operationContext.transactionId) } else payload else null

logger.message: Executing HTTP request with request config: #[output json --- {operationContext: vars.operationContext, remoteCall: vars.remoteCall, requestConfig: vars.requestConfig}]

choice.doc:name: Error contains an HTTP Status Code?

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { message: "The remote service returned a transient error", isTransient: true, }

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Remote Service Error
raise-error.description: The remote service returned a non-transient error

logger.message: Remote service returned an error for a proxy operation. Remote response will be returned as-is.

set-variable.value:
#[output java
import * from modules::httpClient::ObjectUtils var code = error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default attributes.statusCode var completed = code != null
--- { code: code default 999, completed: completed, payload: if (completed) if (code < 400) if (vars.requestConfig.outboundTracking.includeResponsePayload) toString(payload, 'response payload not available') else "response payload omitted" else toString(error.errorMessage.payload, 'response payload not available') else 'response payload not available', timestamp: now() }]

logger.message: Outbount tracking event won't be published (oubountTrackingEvent.publish = false)
